title: Alternatives to Signicat | Market comparison
summary: Alternatives to Signicat compared: Authologic, Didit, IDnow, Idura, Namirial, Veriff and WebID by main method, eID coverage and EUDI Wallet status.
body_markdown:
*Identity providers to consider instead of, or alongside, Signicat, grouped by what your onboarding needs.*


Alternatives to Signicat include Authologic, Didit, IDnow, Idura, Namirial, Veriff and WebID. The right alternative depends on what you use Signicat for: national eIDs and digital identity wallets, qualified electronic signatures, video identification, or document and selfie verification. Signicat combines several of these in one platform; each alternative below leads with a different method.
